@using BloodPressureAppLibrary
@using MudBlazor

@inject IDialogService DialogService

<MudForm @ref="form">
    <MudGrid Spacing="3">
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
            <MudTextField @bind-Value="Therapy.Name" Label="Nome Farmaco/Terapia" Required="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="w-100" />
        </MudItem>
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
            <MudSelect T="TherapyType" @bind-Value="Therapy.Type" Label="Tipo" Required="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="w-100">
                @foreach (var type in Enum.GetValues<TherapyType>())
                {
                    <MudSelectItem Value="@type">@type</MudSelectItem>
                }
            </MudSelect>
        </MudItem>
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
            <MudTextField @bind-Value="Therapy.Dosage" Label="Dosaggio" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="w-100" Placeholder="es. 10mg, 1 compressa" />
        </MudItem>

        <!-- Frequenza strutturata -->
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
            <MudSelect T="FrequencyType" @bind-Value="Therapy.FrequencyType" Label="Frequenza" Required="true" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="w-100">
                <MudSelectItem Value="@FrequencyType.OnceDaily">1 volta al giorno</MudSelectItem>
                <MudSelectItem Value="@FrequencyType.TwiceDaily">2 volte al giorno (mattina/sera)</MudSelectItem>
                <MudSelectItem Value="@FrequencyType.ThreeTimesDaily">3 volte al giorno (mattina/pomeriggio/sera)</MudSelectItem>
                <MudSelectItem Value="@FrequencyType.EveryXHours">Ogni X ore</MudSelectItem>
                <MudSelectItem Value="@FrequencyType.CustomTimes">Orari personalizzati</MudSelectItem>
            </MudSelect>
        </MudItem>

        <!-- Campo "Ogni X ore" -->
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" Class="@(Therapy.FrequencyType == FrequencyType.EveryXHours ? "" : "d-none")">
            <MudNumericField @bind-Value="Therapy.EveryHours" Label="Ogni quante ore" Min="1" Max="23" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="w-100" Required="true" />
        </MudItem>

        <!-- Orari personalizzati -->
        <MudItem xs="12" Class="@(Therapy.FrequencyType == FrequencyType.CustomTimes ? "" : "d-none")">
            <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mb-2">Orari delle dosi (formato HH:mm, uno per riga):</MudText>
            <MudTextField @bind-Value="customTimesText" Label="Orari" Variant="Variant.Outlined" MultiLine="true" Rows="4" Class="w-100" Placeholder="08:00&#10;14:00&#10;20:00" HelperText="Un orario per riga, formato 24h (es. 08:00)" />
        </MudItem>

        <MudItem xs="12">
            <MudTextField @bind-Value="Therapy.Instructions" Label="Istruzioni" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="w-100" Placeholder="es. Dopo i pasti, a stomaco vuoto" />
        </MudItem>
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
            <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="startDate" Label="Data Inizio" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="w-100" />
        </MudItem>
        <MudItem xs="12" sm="6">
            <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="endDate" Label="Data Fine (opzionale)" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Class="w-100" />
        </MudItem>
        <MudItem xs="12">
            <MudSwitch @bind-Checked="Therapy.IsActive" Label="Terapia Attiva" Color="Color.Success" T="bool" />
        </MudItem>
        <MudItem xs="12">
            <MudTextField @bind-Value="Therapy.Notes" Label="Note" Variant="Variant.Outlined" MultiLine="true" Rows="3" Class="w-100" />
        </MudItem>
    </MudGrid>
</MudForm>

@code {
    [CascadingParameter]
    public IMudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;

    [Parameter]
    public Therapy? Therapy { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public bool IsNew { get; set; }

    private MudForm? form;
    private DateTime? startDate;
    private DateTime? endDate;
    private string customTimesText = "";

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        if (Therapy == null)
        {
            Therapy = new Therapy();
            startDate = DateTime.Today;
        }
        else
        {
            startDate = Therapy.StartDate;
            endDate = Therapy.EndDate;

            // Popola il testo degli orari personalizzati
            if (Therapy.FrequencyType == FrequencyType.CustomTimes && Therapy.CustomTimes.Any())
            {
                customTimesText = string.Join(Environment.NewLine,
                    Therapy.CustomTimes.OrderBy(t => t).Select(t => t.ToString("HH:mm")));
            }
        }
    }

    private void UpdateDates()
    {
        if (Therapy != null)
        {
            Therapy.StartDate = startDate ?? DateTime.Today;
            Therapy.EndDate = endDate;

            // Parsa orari personalizzati
            if (Therapy.FrequencyType == FrequencyType.CustomTimes)
            {
                Therapy.CustomTimes = ParseCustomTimes(customTimesText);
            }
        }
    }

    private List<TimeOnly> ParseCustomTimes(string text)
    {
        var times = new List<TimeOnly>();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)) return times;

        var lines = text.Split(new[] { '\r', '\n' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        foreach (var line in lines)
        {
            var trimmed = line.Trim();
            if (TimeOnly.TryParse(trimmed, out var time))
            {
                times.Add(time);
            }
        }
        return times.OrderBy(t => t).ToList();
    }

    public void Cancel()
    {
        MudDialog.Cancel();
    }

    public async Task Submit()
    {
        UpdateDates();

        if (form != null)
        {
            await form.Validate();
            if (!form.IsValid) return;
        }

        // Aggiorna anche il campo legacy Frequency per compatibilità display
        Therapy.Frequency = Therapy.GetFrequencyDisplay();

        MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(Therapy));
    }
}

.page {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

main {
    flex: 1;
}

.sidebar {
    background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(5, 39, 103) 0%, #3a0647 70%);
}

.top-row {
    background-color: #f7f7f7;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #d6d5d5;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    height: 3.5rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

    .top-row ::deep a, .top-row ::deep .btn-link {
        white-space: nowrap;
        margin-left: 1.5rem;
        text-decoration: none;
    }

    .top-row ::deep a:hover, .top-row ::deep .btn-link:hover {
        text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .top-row ::deep a:first-child {
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

@media (max-width: 640.98px) {
    .top-row {
        justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .top-row ::deep a, .top-row ::deep .btn-link {
        margin-left: 0;
    }
}

@media (min-width: 641px) {
    .page {
        flex-direction: row;
    }

    .sidebar {
        width: 250px;
        height: 100vh;
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
    }

    .top-row {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 1;
    }

    .top-row.auth ::deep a:first-child {
        flex: 1;
        text-align: right;
        width: 0;
    }

    .top-row, article {
        padding-left: 2rem !important;
        padding-right: 1.5rem !important;
    }
}

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization
@inject ILocalStorageService localStorage
@inject ProductionAuthStateProvider auth
@inject NavigationManager Navigation
<MudNavMenu>
    <MudNavLink Href="" Match="NavLinkMatch.All" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Home">Home</MudNavLink>
    <MudNavLink Href="/bloodpressure" Match="NavLinkMatch.All" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MonitorHeart">Pressione</MudNavLink>
    <MudNavLink Href="/therapies" Match="NavLinkMatch.All" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Medication">Terapie</MudNavLink>

    <AuthorizeView Context="authState">
        <Authorized>
             <MudNavLink Href="/user" Match="NavLinkMatch.Prefix" Icon="@Icons.Material.Sharp.SupervisedUserCircle">
                @if (authState.User?.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
                {
                    @((authState.User.Identity?.Name) ?? String.Join(" , ", authState.User.Claims.Where(cl => cl.Type.Contains("_name")).Select(cl => cl.Value)))
                }
                else
                {
                    <span>Utente</span>
                }
            </MudNavLink>

            <MudNavLink Href="#" Match="NavLinkMatch.All">
                <MudButton Variant="Variant.Text" Color="Color.Default" OnClick="Logout" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Logout">Logout</MudButton>
            </MudNavLink>
        </Authorized>
        <NotAuthorized>
            <MudNavLink Href="/login" Match="NavLinkMatch.Prefix" Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.SupervisedUserCircle">Login</MudNavLink>
        </NotAuthorized>
    </AuthorizeView>
</MudNavMenu>

@code {
    private async Task Logout()
    {
        try
        {
            await localStorage.RemoveItemAsync("authToken");
        }
        catch
        {
            // ignore
        }

        auth.Logout();
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/", forceLoad: false);
    }
}

@page "/bloodPressure"
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http
@using System.Globalization
@using System.Text
@using MudBlazor.Charts
@inject IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory
@inject ILocalStorageService localstorage
@inject BloodPressureAppWasm.Services.SyncService SyncService
@inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider
@inject IJSRuntime JSRuntime

<PageTitle>Pressioni Sanguinee</PageTitle>
@if (IsLoading)
{
    <Loading></Loading>
}
else
{
    <AuthorizeView>
        <Authorized>
            <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Large" Class="mt-4">
                <MudPaper Elevation="4" Class="pa-6 rounded-lg mb-6" Style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30,30,45,0.95) 0%, rgba(26,26,39,0.95) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(126,111,255,0.15);">
                    <MudStack Row="true" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Justify="Justify.SpaceBetween" Class="mb-6">
                        <MudStack Row="true" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Spacing="3">
                            <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.MonitorHeart" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" />
                            <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="fw-bold">Andamento Pressioni Sanguinee</MudText>
                        </MudStack>
                        <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Add" OnClick="OpenPopover" Class="rounded-lg pa-3">
                            Nuova Misurazione
                        </MudButton>
                    </MudStack>

                    <!-- Filter Controls Section -->
                    <MudGrid Spacing="3" Class="mb-6">
                        <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="4">
                            <MudSelect T="int" Label="Anno" Value="SelectedYear" ValueChanged="OnYearChanged" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true" Class="rounded-lg">
                                @foreach (var year in Years)
                                {
                                    <MudSelectItem Value="year">@year</MudSelectItem>
                                }
                            </MudSelect>
                        </MudItem>
                        <MudItem xs="12" sm="6" md="8">
                            <MudSelect T="string" Label="Periodo di Riferimento" Value="SelectedPeriod" ValueChanged="OnPeriodChanged" Variant="Variant.Outlined" Dense="true" Class="rounded-lg">
                                <MudSelectItem Value="@("AnnoSelezionato")">Tutto l'anno selezionato (@SelectedYear)</MudSelectItem>
                                <MudSelectItem Value="@("Ultimi3")">Ultimi 3 mesi</MudSelectItem>
                                <MudSelectItem Value="@("Ultimi6")">Ultimi 6 mesi</MudSelectItem>
                                <MudSelectItem Value="@("Ultimi12")">Ultimi 12 mesi</MudSelectItem>
                                <MudSelectItem Value="@("Ultimi24")">Ultimi 24 mesi</MudSelectItem>
                                <MudSelectItem Value="@("Tutti")">Tutti i dati disponibili</MudSelectItem>
                            </MudSelect>
                        </MudItem>
                    </MudGrid>

                    <!-- Chart Container -->
                    <MudPaper Elevation="0" Class="pa-4 rounded-lg" Style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                        @if (chartData != null && chartData.Any() && chartData[0].Data.Length > 0)
                        {
                            <MudChart ChartType="chartType" ChartSeries="@chartData" XAxisLabels="@_xAxisLabels" Options="@chartOptions" Width="100%" Height="350px" />
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <MudStack AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Justify="Justify.Center" Class="pa-12">
                                <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Timeline" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Default" Class="mb-2" />
                                <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="text-secondary">Nessun dato disponibile per il periodo selezionato</MudText>
                            </MudStack>
                        }
                    </MudPaper>

                    <!-- Actions Toolbar -->
                    <MudToolBar Class="px-0 mt-4">
                        <MudSpacer />
                        <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.FileDownload" OnClick="ExportCsv" Color="Color.Default" Class="rounded-lg">
                            Esporta CSV
                        </MudButton>
                    </MudToolBar>
                </MudPaper>

                <!-- New Measurement Popover Modal -->
                <MudPopover Open="@isPopoverOpen" AnchorOrigin="Origin.CenterCenter" TransformOrigin="Origin.CenterCenter">
                    <MudPaper Class="pa-6 rounded-lg" Style="min-width: 360px; border: 1px solid rgba(126,111,255,0.3);">
                        <MudStack Row="true" Justify="Justify.SpaceBetween" AlignItems="AlignItems.Center" Class="mb-4">
                            <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="fw-bold">Nuova Misurazione</MudText>
                            <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Outlined.Close" Color="Color.Default" OnClick="OpenPopover" Size="Size.Small" />
                        </MudStack>
                        <MudForm @ref="_form">
                            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(validationMessage))
                            {
                                <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Warning" Class="mb-3">@validationMessage</MudAlert>
                            }
                            <MudNumericField Value="newBloodPressure.Systolic == 0 ? (int?)null : newBloodPressure.Systolic" ValueChanged="(int? val) => newBloodPressure.Systolic = val ?? 0" Label="Sistolica (Massima)" Placeholder="es. 120" Required="true" Min="50" Max="250" HideSpinButtons="true" Class="mb-3" Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
                            <MudNumericField Value="newBloodPressure.Diastolic == 0 ? (int?)null : newBloodPressure.Diastolic" ValueChanged="(int? val) => newBloodPressure.Diastolic = val ?? 0" Label="Diastolica (Minima)" Placeholder="es. 80" Required="true" Min="30" Max="170" HideSpinButtons="true" Class="mb-3" Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
                            <MudNumericField Value="newBloodPressure.Pulse == 0 ? (int?)null : newBloodPressure.Pulse" ValueChanged="(int? val) => newBloodPressure.Pulse = val ?? 0" Label="Pulsazioni (Battiti/min)" Placeholder="es. 70" Required="true" Min="30" Max="220" HideSpinButtons="true" Class="mb-3" Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
                            <MudTextField @bind-Value="newBloodPressure.Device" Label="Dispositivo" Placeholder="es. Omron, Smartwatch" Class="mb-3" Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
                            <MudTextField @bind-Value="newBloodPressure.Context" Label="Contesto" Placeholder="es. A riposo, Dopo caffè" Class="mb-3" Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
                            <MudDatePicker Label="Data misurazione" @bind-Date="_date" Class="mb-6" Variant="Variant.Outlined" />
                            <MudStack Row="true" Justify="Justify.FlexEnd" Spacing="2">
                                <MudButton Variant="Variant.Outlined" Color="Color.Default" OnClick="ClearPopover" Class="rounded-lg">Annulla</MudButton>
                                <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="SubmitForm" Class="rounded-lg">Salva</MudButton>
                            </MudStack>
                        </MudForm>
                    </MudPaper>
                </MudPopover>

                @if (message != null)
                {
                    <MudAlert Severity="@(message.Item1 ? Severity.Success : Severity.Error)" Class="mt-4 rounded-lg">@message.Item2</MudAlert>
                }
            </MudContainer>
        </Authorized>
        <NotAuthorized>
            <MudContainer MaxWidth="MaxWidth.Small" Class="mt-12 text-center">
                <MudPaper Elevation="3" Class="pa-8 rounded-lg">
                    <MudIcon Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Lock" Size="Size.Large" Color="Color.Primary" Class="mb-4" />
                    <MudText Typo="Typo.h5" Class="mb-2">Accesso Riservato</MudText>
                    <MudText Typo="Typo.body1" Class="text-secondary mb-6">Devi effettuare l'accesso per visualizzare e gestire le tue misurazioni.</MudText>
                    <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large" Href="login" StartIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Login">
                        Vai al Login
                    </MudButton>
                </MudPaper>
            </MudContainer>
        </NotAuthorized>
    </AuthorizeView>
}

@code {
    private bool IsLoading { get; set; } = false;
    private List<ChartSeries> chartData;
    private ChartOptions chartOptions;
    private BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure newBloodPressure = new();
    private List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure> bloodPressureData;
    private List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure> AllbloodPressureData;
    private bool isPopoverOpen = false;
    private string? validationMessage;
    private int SelectedYear;
    private string SelectedPeriod = "AnnoSelezionato";
    private MudForm _form;
    private List<int> Years = new();
    private HttpClient httpClient;
    private ChartType chartType = ChartType.Line;
    private string[] _xAxisLabels = { "" };
    private Tuple<bool, string>? message;

    private DateTime? _date
    {
        get => newBloodPressure.Timestamp;
        set => newBloodPressure.Timestamp = value ?? DateTime.Today;
    }

    private void OpenPopover()
    {
        message = null;
        validationMessage = null;
        isPopoverOpen = !isPopoverOpen;
        newBloodPressure = new BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure
        {
            Timestamp = DateTime.Now
        };
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        message = null;
        IsLoading = true;
        httpClient = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Api");

        // Tenta di sincronizzare i dati offline pendenti
        try
        {
            await SyncService.SyncPendingDataAsync();
        }
        catch { /* Ignora se offline */ }

        AllbloodPressureData = await FetchBloodPressureDataAsync();

        Years = AllbloodPressureData
            .Where(bp => bp.Timestamp != null)
            .Select(bp => bp.Timestamp.Year)
            .Distinct()
            .OrderByDescending(y => y)
            .ToList();

        if (!Years.Any())
        {
            Years = new List<int> { DateTime.Now.Year };
        }

        SelectedYear = Years.FirstOrDefault();
        SelectedPeriod = "AnnoSelezionato";

        UpdateChartData();
        IsLoading = false;
    }

    private void OnYearChanged(int newYear)
    {
        SelectedYear = newYear;
        UpdateChartData();
    }

    private void OnPeriodChanged(string newPeriod)
    {
        SelectedPeriod = newPeriod;
        UpdateChartData();
    }

    private void UpdateChartData()
    {
        if (AllbloodPressureData == null) return;

        DateTime? startDate = null;
        DateTime? endDate = null;

        switch (SelectedPeriod)
        {
            case "Tutti":
                startDate = null;
                endDate = null;
                break;
            case "AnnoSelezionato":
                startDate = new DateTime(SelectedYear, 1, 1);
                endDate = new DateTime(SelectedYear, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59);
                break;
            case "Ultimi3":
                endDate = DateTime.Now;
                startDate = endDate.Value.AddMonths(-3);
                break;
            case "Ultimi6":
                endDate = DateTime.Now;
                startDate = endDate.Value.AddMonths(-6);
                break;
            case "Ultimi12":
                endDate = DateTime.Now;
                startDate = endDate.Value.AddMonths(-12);
                break;
            case "Ultimi24":
                endDate = DateTime.Now;
                startDate = endDate.Value.AddMonths(-24);
                break;
            default:
                startDate = new DateTime(SelectedYear, 1, 1);
                endDate = new DateTime(SelectedYear, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59);
                break;
        }

        IEnumerable<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure> query = AllbloodPressureData;

        if (startDate.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(bp => bp.Timestamp >= startDate.Value);

        if (endDate.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(bp => bp.Timestamp <= endDate.Value);

        bloodPressureData = query.OrderBy(bpd => bpd.Timestamp).ToList();

        if (!bloodPressureData.Any())
        {
            _xAxisLabels = new string[] { "" };
            chartData = new List<ChartSeries>
            {
                new ChartSeries { Name = "Sistolica", Data = Array.Empty<double>() },
                new ChartSeries { Name = "Diastolica", Data = Array.Empty<double>() },
                new ChartSeries { Name = "Pulsazioni", Data = Array.Empty<double>() }
            };
            chartType = ChartType.Bar;
            return;
        }

        _xAxisLabels = bloodPressureData.Select(bPD => bPD.Timestamp.ToString("dd/MMM")).ToArray();

        chartData = new List<ChartSeries>
        {
            new ChartSeries
            {
                Name = "Sistolica",
                Data = bloodPressureData.Select(x => (double)x.Systolic).ToArray()
            },
            new ChartSeries
            {
                Name = "Diastolica",
                Data = bloodPressureData.Select(x => (double)x.Diastolic).ToArray()
            },
            new ChartSeries
            {
                Name = "Pulsazioni",
                Data = bloodPressureData.Select(x => (double)x.Pulse).ToArray()
            }
        };

        chartType = chartData[0].Data.Length < 3 ? ChartType.Bar : ChartType.Line;

        chartOptions = new ChartOptions
        {
            YAxisTicks = 20
        };

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task<List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>> FetchBloodPressureDataAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
            string id = "";
            if (authState.User.Identity is { IsAuthenticated: true })
            {
                var user = authState.User;
                id = user.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(cl => cl.Type == "nameid")?.Value;
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
            {
                return new List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>();
            }

            var response = await httpClient.GetAsync($"api/bloodpressure/{id}");
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                var bloodPressures = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>>();
                return bloodPressures ?? new List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>();
            }
            return new List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>();
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return new List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>();
        }
    }

    private async Task SubmitForm()
    {
        if (newBloodPressure.Systolic <= newBloodPressure.Diastolic)
        {
            validationMessage = "Attenzione: La Sistolica deve essere superiore alla Diastolica.";
            return;
        }

        if (_form != null)
        {
            await _form.Validate();
            if (!_form.IsValid) return;
        }

        validationMessage = null;
        isPopoverOpen = false;

        try
        {
            var response = await httpClient.PostAsJsonAsync("api/bloodpressure", newBloodPressure);
            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                message = new Tuple<bool, string>(false, response.ReasonPhrase ?? "Errore nel salvataggio");
            }
            else
            {
                message = new Tuple<bool, string>(true, "Salvato e sincronizzato correttamente");
                AllbloodPressureData.Add(newBloodPressure);
                UpdateChartData();
                newBloodPressure = new BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure { Timestamp = DateTime.Now };
            }
        }
        catch (HttpRequestException)
        {
            // Modalità Offline: salviamo nella coda locale
            await SyncService.EnqueueMeasurementAsync(newBloodPressure);
            message = new Tuple<bool, string>(true, "Sei offline: misurazione salvata in locale. Verrà sincronizzata alla prossima connessione.");
            AllbloodPressureData.Add(newBloodPressure);
            UpdateChartData();
            newBloodPressure = new BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure { Timestamp = DateTime.Now };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            message = new Tuple<bool, string>(false, $"Errore: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    private void ClearPopover()
    {
        newBloodPressure = new BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure { Timestamp = DateTime.Now };
        isPopoverOpen = false;
    }

    private async Task ExportCsv()
    {
        if (AllbloodPressureData == null || !AllbloodPressureData.Any())
        {
            message = new Tuple<bool, string>(false, "Nessun dato da esportare");
            return;
        }

        var csvBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        csvBuilder.AppendLine("Data,Sistolica,Diastolica,Pulsazioni,Dispositivo,Contesto");

        foreach (var bp in AllbloodPressureData.OrderBy(b => b.Timestamp))
        {
            csvBuilder.AppendLine($"{bp.Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm},{bp.Systolic},{bp.Diastolic},{bp.Pulse},\"{bp.Device}\",\"{bp.Context}\"");
        }

        var csvContent = csvBuilder.ToString();
        await JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("saveAsFile", "bloodpressure_data.csv", csvContent);
    }
}

<MudGrid>

        <MudCard Class="pa-6">
            <MudCardContent>
                <MudText Typo="Typo.h4" Align="Align.Center" Class="mb-4">Recupero Password</MudText>
                <MudText Typo="Typo.body2" Class="mb-4 text-secondary">
                    Inserisci il tuo username per ricevere le istruzioni di recupero password via email.
                </MudText>

                @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Message))
                {
                    <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Success" Class="mt-4">@Message</MudAlert>
                }

                @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Error))
                {
                    <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Class="mt-4">@Error</MudAlert>
                }

                <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" OnClick="Submit" Class="mt-4" FullWidth="true">Invia Richiesta</MudButton>
            </MudCardContent>
            <MudCardActions Class="justify-center">
                <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">Hai ricordato la password? <MudLink Href="/login">Accedi</MudLink></MudText>

@code {
    private string Username { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    private string? Message;
    private string? Error;

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        Message = null;
        Error = null;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Username))
        {
            Error = "Inserisci un username valido.";
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            var client = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Auth");
            var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("forgot-password", new { Username });
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                Message = "Se l'utente esiste, riceverai un'email con le istruzioni.";
            }
            else
            {
                Error = "Si è verificato un errore durante la richiesta (Backend Error).";
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Error = $"Errore di connessione al server: {ex.Message}";
        }
    }
}

                          Adornment="Adornment.Start" AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Person"
                          Class="mt-4" Immediate="true" KeyUp="HandleKeyUp" />

            <MudTextField @bind-Value="Password" Label="Password" Variant="Variant.Outlined"
                          InputType="InputType.Password" Adornment="Adornment.Start"
                          AdornmentIcon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Lock" Class="mt-4"
                          Immediate="true" KeyUp="HandleKeyUp" />

            <div class="d-flex justify-end mt-1">
                <MudLink Href="/forgot-password" Typo="Typo.caption" Color="Color.Primary">Password dimenticata?</MudLink>
            </div>

            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Error))
            {
                <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error" Variant="Variant.Filled" Class="mt-4" Dense="true">@Error</MudAlert>
            }

            <MudButton Variant="Variant.Filled" Color="Color.Primary" Size="Size.Large"
                       OnClick="LoginUser" Class="mt-6 py-3" FullWidth="true"
                       Disabled="@Processing">
                @if (Processing)
                {
                    <MudProgressCircular Class="ms-n1" Size="Size.Small" Indeterminate="true" />
                    <MudText Class="ms-2">Accesso in corso...</MudText>
                }
                else
                {
                    <MudText>Accedi</MudText>
                }
            </MudButton>

            <MudDivider Class="my-6" />

            <div class="d-flex justify-center">
                <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">Non hai un account? <MudLink Href="/register" Color="Color.Primary" Class="fw-bold">Registrati</MudLink></MudText>
            </div>
        </MudPaper>
    </MudItem>
</MudGrid>

@code {
    [Parameter, SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    public string? ReturnUrl { get; set; }
    private string Username { get; set; } = "";
    private string Password { get; set; } = "";
    private string Error { get; set; } = "";
    private bool Processing { get; set; }

    private async Task HandleKeyUp(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == "Enter")
        {
            await LoginUser();
        }
    }

    public async Task LoginUser()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Username) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Password))
        {
            Error = "Inserisci username e password";
            return;
        }

        Processing = true;
        Error = "";
        try
        {
            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "api/auth/login")
            {
                Content = JsonContent.Create(new { Username, Password })
            };
            request.SetBrowserRequestCredentials(BrowserRequestCredentials.Include);

            var response = await httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Api").SendAsync(request);

            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JwtResponse>();
                if (result?.Token is not null)
                {
                    await LocalStorage.SetItemAsync("authToken", result.Token);
                    AuthProvider.NotifyUserAuthentication(result.Token);
                    Navigation.NavigateTo(GetSafeReturnUrl(ReturnUrl));
                    return;
                }
                Error = "Errore: Risposta del server non valida";
            }
            else if (response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
            {
                Error = "Credenziali non valide";
            }
            else
            {
                Error = $"Errore del server: {response.StatusCode}";
            }
        }
        catch (HttpRequestException ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Errore di rete: {ex.Message}");
            Error = "Il server non risponde. Controlla la tua connessione o riprova più tardi.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Errore inaspettato: {ex.Message}");
            Error = "Si è verificato un errore durante l'accesso.";
        }
        finally
        {
            Processing = false;
        }
    }

    private static bool IsSafeReturnUrl(string? url)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))
            return false;

        var trimmed = url.Trim();

        if (Uri.TryCreate(trimmed, UriKind.Absolute, out _))
            return false;

        if (trimmed.StartsWith("//") || trimmed.Contains("..") || trimmed.Contains("\\"))
            return false;

        return trimmed.StartsWith("/");
    }

    private static string GetSafeReturnUrl(string? returnUrl)
    {
        if (IsSafeReturnUrl(returnUrl))
            return returnUrl!.Trim();
        return "/bloodpressure";
    }

    private class JwtResponse
    {
        public string Token { get; set; }
    }
}

@code {
    [Parameter, SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    public string? Token { get; set; }

    private string NewPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    private string? Message;
    private string? Error;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        // Se il token è presente nella query string, viene mappato automaticamente alla proprietà
    }

    private async Task Submit()
    {
        Message = null;
        Error = null;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Token) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(NewPassword))
        {
            Error = "Token o nuova password non validi.";
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            var client = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Auth");
            var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("reset-password", new { Token, NewPassword });
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                Message = "Password aggiornata con successo. Reindirizzamento al login...";
                await Task.Delay(2000);
                Navigation.NavigateTo("/login");
            }
            else
            {
                Error = "Token non valido o scaduto.";
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Error = $"Errore di connessione al server: {ex.Message}";
        }
    }
}

@page "/therapies"

@code {
    private List<Therapy>? therapies;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadTherapiesAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadTherapiesAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
            string? patientId = null;

            if (authState.User.Identity is { IsAuthenticated: true })
            {
                var user = authState.User;
                patientId = user.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(cl => cl.Type == "nameid")?.Value
                           ?? user.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(cl => cl.Type == "sub")?.Value;
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(patientId))
            {
                var client = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Api");
                var response = await client.GetAsync($"api/therapies/{patientId}");
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    therapies = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<List<Therapy>>();
                }
                else
                {
                    therapies = await ReminderService.GetTherapiesAsync();
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Errore nel caricamento terapie: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
            therapies = await ReminderService.GetTherapiesAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenTherapyDialog(Therapy? therapy = null)
    {
        var parameters = new DialogParameters
        {
            { nameof(DialogContent.Therapy), therapy },
            { nameof(DialogContent.IsNew), therapy == null }
        };

        var options = new DialogOptions { CloseOnEscapeKey = true, MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Medium, FullWidth = true };
        var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<DialogContent>(therapy == null ? "Nuova Terapia" : "Modifica Terapia", parameters, options);
        var result = await dialog.Result;

        if (!result.Canceled && result.Data is Therapy savedTherapy)
        {
            await SaveTherapy(savedTherapy, therapy == null);
        }
    }

    private async Task SaveTherapy(Therapy therapyModel, bool isNew)
    {
        try
        {
            var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
            string? patientId = null;

            if (authState.User.Identity is { IsAuthenticated: true })
            {
                var user = authState.User;
                patientId = user.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(cl => cl.Type == "nameid")?.Value
                           ?? user.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(cl => cl.Type == "sub")?.Value;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(patientId))
            {
                Snackbar.Add("Errore: utente non autenticato", Severity.Error);
                return;
            }

            therapyModel.PatientId = ObjectId.Parse(patientId);

            var client = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Api");
            bool success = false;

            if (isNew)
            {
                var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("api/therapies", therapyModel);
                success = response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }
            else
            {
                var response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync($"api/therapies/{therapyModel.Id}", therapyModel);
                success = response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            }

            if (success)
            {
                Snackbar.Add(isNew ? "Terapia aggiunta con successo" : "Terapia aggiornata con successo", Severity.Success);
                await LoadTherapiesAsync();
            }
            else
            {
                // Fallback to offline storage
                await ReminderService.EnqueueTherapyAsync(therapyModel);
                Snackbar.Add("Salvato in locale (offline)", Severity.Info);
                await LoadTherapiesAsync();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // Offline fallback
            await ReminderService.EnqueueTherapyAsync(therapyModel);
            Snackbar.Add($"Salvato in locale (offline): {ex.Message}", Severity.Info);
            await LoadTherapiesAsync();
        }
    }

    private async Task DeleteTherapy(Therapy therapy)
    {
        var confirmed = await JSRuntime.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm", "Eliminare questa terapia?");

        if (!confirmed) return;

        try
        {
            var client = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Api");
            var response = await client.DeleteAsync($"api/therapies/{therapy.Id}");

            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                await ReminderService.DeleteTherapyAsync(therapy);
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            await ReminderService.DeleteTherapyAsync(therapy);
        }

        await LoadTherapiesAsync();
        Snackbar.Add("Terapia eliminata", Severity.Success);
    }

    private async Task SetReminder(Therapy therapy)
    {
        // Set notification reminder using PushNotificationService
        if (!therapy.IsActive)
        {
            Snackbar.Add("La terapia non è attiva", Severity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            // Usa il nuovo sistema strutturato GetDoseTimes()
            var doseTimes = therapy.GetDoseTimes().ToList();

            bool anyScheduled = false;

            foreach (var time in doseTimes)
            {
                var now = DateTime.Now;
                var nextDose = DateTime.Today.Add(time.ToTimeSpan());

                if (nextDose <= now)
                    nextDose = nextDose.AddDays(1);

                var delay = (long)(nextDose - now).TotalMilliseconds;

                // Programma via PushNotificationService (usa Service Worker per persistenza)
                await PushNotificationService.ScheduleLocalNotificationAsync(
                    therapy.Name,
                    therapy.Dosage ?? "",
                    delay,
                    therapy.Id?.ToString() ?? "");

                anyScheduled = true;
            }

            if (anyScheduled)
            {
                Snackbar.Add($"Reminder impostati per {therapy.Name} ({string.Join(", ", doseTimes.Select(t => t.ToString("HH:mm")))})", Severity.Success);

                // Inizializza push notifications se non già fatto (richiede permessi + registra subscription)
                await PushNotificationService.InitializeAsync();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Errore nell'impostare reminder: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }

    // Metodo legacy mantenuto per compatibilità con vecchi dati
    private List<TimeSpan> ParseFrequencyToTimes(string? frequency)
    {
        var times = new List<TimeSpan>();

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(frequency))
        {
            // Default: once daily at 8 AM
            times.Add(new TimeSpan(8, 0, 0));
            return times;
        }

        var freq = frequency.ToLowerInvariant();

        if (freq.Contains("ogni"))
        {
            // "Ogni 8 ore" -> every 8 hours starting from 8 AM
            var match = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(freq, @"ogni\s+(\d+)\s*ore?");
            if (match.Success && int.TryParse(match.Groups[1].Value, out int hours))
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < 24; i += hours)
                {
                    times.Add(new TimeSpan(i, 0, 0));
                }
            }
        }
        else if (freq.Contains("volta"))
        {
            // "1 volta al giorno", "2 volte al giorno"
            var match = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(freq, @"(\d+)\s*volta");
            if (match.Success && int.TryParse(match.Groups[1].Value, out int count))
            {
                if (count == 1)
                    times.Add(new TimeSpan(8, 0, 0));
                else if (count == 2)
                {
                    times.Add(new TimeSpan(8, 0, 0));
                    times.Add(new TimeSpan(20, 0, 0));
                }
                else if (count == 3)
                {
                    times.Add(new TimeSpan(8, 0, 0));
                    times.Add(new TimeSpan(14, 0, 0));
                    times.Add(new TimeSpan(20, 0, 0));
                }
                else
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                    {
                        times.Add(new TimeSpan(8 + (i * (16 / count)), 0, 0));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            // Default fallback
            times.Add(new TimeSpan(8, 0, 0));
        }

        return times;
    }
}

@code {
    private Patient? patient;
    private MudForm? _form;
    private string? NewPassword;
    private string? ConfirmPassword;
    private HttpClient? httpClient;
    private bool IsLoading = true;

    private DateTime? _birthDate
    {
        get => patient?.BirthDate;
        set { if (patient != null && value.HasValue) patient.BirthDate = value.Value; }
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        httpClient = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Api");
        await LoadProfileAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadProfileAsync()
    {
        IsLoading = true;
        try
        {
            var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
            if (authState.User.Identity is { IsAuthenticated: true })
            {
                var user = authState.User;

                // 1. Prova prima con l'ObjectId (NameIdentifier o nameid)
                var userId = user.Claims.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == "nameid")?.Value
                             ?? user.Claims.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
                {
                    try
                    {
                        patient = await httpClient!.GetFromJsonAsync<Patient>($"api/patients/{userId}");
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        patient = null;
                    }
                }

                // 2. Fallback: prova per Email/Username claim se l'ID fallisce
                if (patient == null)
                {
                    var username = user.Claims.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == ClaimTypes.Email)?.Value
                                  ?? user.Claims.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Type == "email")?.Value
                                  ?? user.Identity?.Name;

                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(username))
                    {
                        patient = await httpClient!.GetFromJsonAsync<Patient>($"api/patients/username/{username}");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Errore nel recupero dati profilo: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            IsLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task SaveProfile()
    {
        if (patient == null || httpClient == null) return;

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(NewPassword))
        {
            if (NewPassword != ConfirmPassword)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("Le password non coincidono", Severity.Warning);
                return;
            }
            patient.Password = NewPassword;
        }

        try
        {
            var response = await httpClient.PutAsJsonAsync("api/patients", patient);
            if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                Snackbar.Add("Profilo aggiornato con successo!", Severity.Success);
                NewPassword = null;
                ConfirmPassword = null;
            }
            else
            {
                Snackbar.Add("Errore durante il salvataggio del profilo", Severity.Error);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Snackbar.Add($"Errore di connessione: {ex.Message}", Severity.Error);
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.JSInterop;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Net.Http.Json;

namespace BloodPressureAppWasm.Services;

public class PushNotificationService
{
    private readonly IJSRuntime _jsRuntime;
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    private const string VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY = "MFkwEwYHKoZIzj0CAQYIKoZIzj0DAQcDQgAE0ASXi9Q2TllApOHO19_hwJqJb5qSX8wJ67Fl4xmLCJw_xCyWmysIynboZGic_0qn8ZNhTks4UGp76JT04pcr5w";

    public PushNotificationService(IJSRuntime jsRuntime, IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory)
    {
        _jsRuntime = jsRuntime;
        _httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Inizializza le notifiche push: richiede permessi, registra subscription, invia al server
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<bool> InitializeAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            // Verifica supporto Service Worker e Push API
            var supported = await _jsRuntime.InvokeAsync<bool>("pushNotifications.isSupported");
            if (!supported)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("Push API non supportata su questo browser");
                return false;
            }

            // Richiedi permessi notifiche
            var permission = await _jsRuntime.InvokeAsync<string>("Notification.requestPermission");
            if (permission != "granted")
            {
                Console.WriteLine("Permessi notifiche negati");
                return false;
            }

            // Registra Service Worker e sottoscrivi a Push
            var subscription = await _jsRuntime.InvokeAsync<PushSubscription?>("pushNotifications.subscribe", VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY);
            if (subscription == null)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("Impossibile creare subscription push");
                return false;
            }

            // Invia subscription al server
            await SendSubscriptionToServerAsync(subscription);

            Console.WriteLine("Push notifications inizializzate correttamente");
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Errore inizializzazione push: {ex.Message}");
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Programma una notifica locale (fallback quando server push non disponibile)
    /// Usa Service Worker per persistere anche a tab chiusa
    /// </summary>
    public async Task ScheduleLocalNotificationAsync(string therapyName, string dosage, long delayMs, string therapyId)
    {
        try
        {
            await _jsRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("pushNotifications.scheduleLocal", new
            {
                therapyName,
                dosage,
                delay = delayMs,
                therapyId
            });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Errore scheduling notifica locale: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Annulla una notifica programmata
    /// </summary>
    public async Task CancelNotificationAsync(string therapyId)
    {
        try
        {
            await _jsRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("pushNotifications.cancel", therapyId);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Errore cancellazione notifica: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Invia la subscription push al backend
    /// </summary>
    private async Task SendSubscriptionToServerAsync(PushSubscription subscription)
    {
        try
        {
            var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Api");
            var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("api/push/subscribe", subscription);

            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"Errore invio subscription: {response.StatusCode}");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Errore connessione server per subscription: {ex.Message}");
            // Salva localmente per retry successivo
            await SaveSubscriptionLocallyAsync(subscription);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Salva subscription in localStorage per retry quando online
    /// </summary>
    private async Task SaveSubscriptionLocallyAsync(PushSubscription subscription)
    {
        try
        {
            await _jsRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("localStorage.setItem", "pushSubscription", JsonSerializer.Serialize(subscription));
        }
        catch { }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tenta di inviare subscription salvate localmente quando si torna online
    /// </summary>
    public async Task RetryPendingSubscriptionsAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var json = await _jsRuntime.InvokeAsync<string>("localStorage.getItem", "pushSubscription");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(json))
            {
                var subscription = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PushSubscription>(json);
                if (subscription != null)
                {
                    await SendSubscriptionToServerAsync(subscription);
                    await _jsRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("localStorage.removeItem", "pushSubscription");
                }
            }
        }
        catch { }
    }
}

public class PushSubscription
{
    public string Endpoint { get; set; } = "";
    public PushSubscriptionKeys Keys { get; set; } = new();
    public DateTime? ExpirationTime { get; set; }
}

public class PushSubscriptionKeys
{
    public string P256dh { get; set; } = "";
    public string Auth { get; set; } = "";
}

```csharp
using Blazored.LocalStorage;
using BloodPressureAppLibrary;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace BloodPressureAppWasm.Services
{
    public class ReminderService
    {
        private readonly ILocalStorageService _localStorage;
        private const string TherapiesKey = "offline_therapies_queue";
        private bool _isSyncing = false;

        public ReminderService(ILocalStorageService localStorage)
        {
            _localStorage = localStorage;
        }

        public async Task<List<Therapy>> GetTherapiesAsync()
        {
            var therapies = await _localStorage.GetItemAsync<List<Therapy>>(TherapiesKey);
            return therapies ?? new List<Therapy>();
        }

        public async Task EnqueueTherapyAsync(Therapy therapy)
        {
            var queue = await _localStorage.GetItemAsync<List<Therapy>>(TherapiesKey)
                        ?? new List<Therapy>();

            // Avoid duplicates by checking if therapy with same name already exists
            if (!queue.Any(t => t.Name == therapy.Name && t.PatientId == therapy.PatientId))
            {
                queue.Add(therapy);
                await _localStorage.SetItemAsync(TherapiesKey, queue);
            }
        }

        public async Task SyncPendingTherapiesAsync(IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory)
        {
            if (_isSyncing) return;

            var queue = await GetTherapiesAsync();
            if (queue == null || !queue.Any()) return;

            _isSyncing = true;
            try
            {
                var client = httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Api");
                var successfullySynced = new List<Therapy>();

                foreach (var item in queue)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("api/therapies", item);
                        if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                        {
                            successfullySynced.Add(item);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            // Se il server rifiuta per qualche motivo logico, interrompiamo o saltiamo
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        // Ancora offline o errore di rete, interrompiamo il ciclo di sync
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (successfullySynced.Any())
                {
                    foreach (var synced in successfullySynced)
                    {
                        queue.Remove(synced);
                    }
                    await _localStorage.SetItemAsync(TherapiesKey, queue);
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                _isSyncing = false;
            }
        }

        public async Task DeleteTherapyAsync(Therapy therapy)
        {
            var queue = await GetTherapiesAsync();
            queue.RemoveAll(t => t.Id == therapy.Id && t.PatientId == therapy.PatientId);
            await _localStorage.SetItemAsync(TherapiesKey, queue);
        }
    }
}

using Blazored.LocalStorage;
using System.Net.Http.Json;

namespace BloodPressureAppWasm.Services;

public class SyncService
{
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    private readonly ILocalStorageService _localStorage;
    private const string OfflineQueueKey = "offline_bloodpressure_queue";
    private bool _isSyncing = false;

    public SyncService(IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory, ILocalStorageService localStorage)
    {
        _httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory;
        _localStorage = localStorage;
    }

    public async Task EnqueueMeasurementAsync(BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure measurement)
    {
        var queue = await _localStorage.GetItemAsync<List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>>(OfflineQueueKey)
                    ?? new List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>();

        queue.Add(measurement);
        await _localStorage.SetItemAsync(OfflineQueueKey, queue);
    }

    public async Task<List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>> GetOfflineQueueAsync()
    {
        return await _localStorage.GetItemAsync<List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>>(OfflineQueueKey)
               ?? new List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>();
    }

    public async Task<bool> SyncPendingDataAsync()
    {
        if (_isSyncing) return false;

        var queue = await GetOfflineQueueAsync();
        if (queue == null || !queue.Any()) return true;

        _isSyncing = true;
        try
        {
            var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Api");
            var successfullySynced = new List<BloodPressureAppLibrary.BloodPressure>();

            foreach (var item in queue)
            {
                try
                {
                    var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("api/bloodpressure", item);
                    if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                    {
                        successfullySynced.Add(item);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // Se il server rifiuta per qualche motivo logico, interrompiamo o saltiamo
                        break;
                    }
                }
                catch
                {
                    // Ancora offline o errore di rete, interrompiamo il ciclo di sync
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (successfullySynced.Any())
            {
                foreach (var synced in successfullySynced)
                {
                    queue.Remove(synced);
                }
                await _localStorage.SetItemAsync(OfflineQueueKey, queue);
            }

            return !queue.Any();
        }
        finally
        {
            _isSyncing = false;
        }
    }
}

// BloodPressureAppWasm - Notification/Reminder System
// Handles browser notifications for medication reminders

function setReminderNotification(therapyName, dosage, delayMs, therapyId) {
    setTimeout(() => {
        if (Notification.permission === "granted") {
            const notification = new Notification("Promemoria Terapia", {
                body: `È ora di prendere: ${therapyName} - ${dosage}`,
                icon: "/icon-192.png",
                badge: "/icon-192.png",
                tag: `therapy-${therapyId}`,
                requireInteraction: true,
                data: {
                    therapyId: therapyId,
                    therapyName: therapyName
                }
            });

            notification.onclick = function() {
                window.focus();
                notification.close();
            };
        }
    }, delayMs);
}

// Request notification permission on page load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'default') {
        Notification.requestPermission().then(function(permission) {
            console.log('Notification permission:', permission);
        });
    }
});

// Register service worker for background notifications
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js')
        .then(function(registration) {
            console.log('Service Worker registered:', registration.scope);
        })
        .catch(function(error) {
            console.log('Service Worker registration failed:', error);
        });
}

## File: wwwroot/js/push-notifications.js
```javascript
// BloodPressureAppWasm - Push Notifications JavaScript Module
// Handles: Push API subscription, local notifications via SW, permission management

const VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY = 'MFkwEwYHKoZIzj0CAQYIKoZIzj0DAQcDQgAE0ASXi9Q2TllApOHO19_hwJqJb5qSX8wJ67Fl4xmLCJw_xCyWmysIynboZGic_0qn8ZNhTks4UGp76JT04pcr5w';

export const pushNotifications = {
    // Verifica supporto Push API
    isSupported: () => {
        return 'serviceWorker' in navigator &&
               'PushManager' in window &&
               'Notification' in window;
    },

    // Richiedi permessi notifiche
    requestPermission: async () => {
        if (!('Notification' in window)) return 'denied';
        if (Notification.permission === 'granted') return 'granted';
        if (Notification.permission === 'denied') return 'denied';

        try {
            const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
            return permission;
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Permission request error:', e);
            return 'denied';
        }
    },

    // Sottoscrivi a Push API via Service Worker
    subscribe: async (vapidKey = VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY) => {
        if (!pushNotifications.isSupported()) {
            console.warn('Push API not supported');
            return null;
        }

        try {
            const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;

            // Verifica subscription esistente
            let subscription = await registration.pushManager.getSubscription();
            if (subscription) {
                console.log('Existing push subscription found');
                return subscription.toJSON();
            }

            // Crea nuova subscription
            const applicationServerKey = urlBase64ToUint8Array(vapidKey);
            subscription = await registration.pushManager.subscribe({
                userVisibleOnly: true,
                applicationServerKey
            });

            console.log('New push subscription created');
            return subscription.toJSON();
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Push subscribe error:', e);
            return null;
        }
    },

    // Programma notifica locale via Service Worker (funziona anche a tab chiusa)
    scheduleLocal: async (data) => {
        if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return;

        try {
            const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
            registration.active?.postMessage({
                type: 'SCHEDULE_LOCAL',
                therapyName: data.therapyName,
                dosage: data.dosage,
                delay: data.delay,
                therapyId: data.therapyId
            });
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Schedule local notification error:', e);

            // Fallback: setTimeout diretto (solo se tab aperta)
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {
                    new Notification('Promemoria Terapia', {
                        body: `È ora di prendere: ${data.therapyName} - ${data.dosage}`,
                        icon: '/icon-192.png',
                        badge: '/icon-192.png',
                        tag: `therapy-${data.therapyId}`,
                        renotify: true,
                        requireInteraction: true
                    });
                }
            }, data.delay);
        }
    },

    // Annulla notifica (rimuove tag)
    cancel: async (therapyId) => {
        if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return;

        try {
            const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
            const notifications = await registration.getNotifications({
                tag: `therapy-${therapyId}`
            });
            notifications.forEach(n => n.close());
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Cancel notification error:', e);
        }
    },

    // Ottieni subscription corrente
    getSubscription: async () => {
        if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return null;

        try {
            const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
            const subscription = await registration.pushManager.getSubscription();
            return subscription?.toJSON() || null;
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Get subscription error:', e);
            return null;
        }
    },

    // Annulla subscription push
    unsubscribe: async () => {
        if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return false;

        try {
            const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
            const subscription = await registration.pushManager.getSubscription();
            if (subscription) {
                await subscription.unsubscribe();
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Unsubscribe error:', e);
            return false;
        }
    }
};

// Helper: Convert base64 to Uint8Array for VAPID key
function urlBase64ToUint8Array(base64String) {
    const padding = '='.repeat((4 - base64String.length % 4) % 4);
    const base64 = (base64String + padding).replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const rawData = atob(base64);
    const outputArray = new Uint8Array(rawData.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < rawData.length; ++i) {
        outputArray[i] = rawData.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return outputArray;
}

// Auto-inizializzazione quando DOM ready
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
    if (pushNotifications.isSupported()) {
        // Registra service worker
        try {
            const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.register('/service-worker.js', {
                updateViaCache: 'none'
            });
            console.log('SW registered:', registration.scope);

            // Listener per messaggi da SW
            navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
                if (event.data?.type === 'THERAPY_REMINDER') {
                    // Emetti evento custom per componenti Blazor
                    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('therapy-reminder', {
                        detail: event.data
                    }));
                }
            });
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('SW registration failed:', e);
        }
    }
});

// Esporta per uso globale (compatibilità)
window.pushNotifications = pushNotifications;

}\n\n  // Responsive containers that are 100% wide until a breakpoint\n  @each $breakpoint, $container-max-width in $container-max-widths {\n    .container-#{$breakpoint} {\n      @extend }\n\n  // Responsive containers that are 100% wide until a breakpoint\n  @each $breakpoint, $container-max-width in $container-max-widths {\n    .container-#{$breakpoint} {\n      @extend .container-fluid;\n    }\n\n    @include media-breakpoint-up($breakpoint, $grid-breakpoints) {\n      %responsive-container-#{$breakpoint} {\n        max-width: $container-max-width;\n      }\n\n      // Extend each breakpoint which is smaller or equal to the current breakpoint\n      $extend-breakpoint: true;\n\n      @each $name, $width in $grid-breakpoints {\n        @if ($extend-breakpoint) {\n stylelint-disable-line function-disallowed-list\n  margin-right: auto;\n  margin-left: auto;\n}\n","// Breakpoint viewport sizes and media queries.\n//\n// Breakpoints are defined as a map of (name: minimum width), order from small to large:\n//\n//    (xs: 0, sm: 576px, md: 768px, lg: 992px, xl: 1200px, xxl: 1400px)\n//\n// The map defined in the `$grid-breakpoints` global variable is used as md: 768px, lg: 992px, xl: 1200px, xxl: 1400px))\n//    md\n//    >> breakpoint-next(sm, $breakpoint-names: (xs sm md lg xl xxl))\n//    md\n@function breakpoint-next($name, $breakpoints: }\n\n  // Responsive containers that are 100% wide until a breakpoint\n  @each $breakpoint, $container-max-width in $container-max-widths {\n    .container-#{$breakpoint} {\n      @extend .container-fluid;\n    }\n\n    @include media-breakpoint-up($breakpoint, $grid-breakpoints) {\n      %responsive-container-#{$breakpoint} {\n        max-width: $container-max-width;\n      }\n\n      // Extend each breakpoint which is smaller or equal to the current breakpoint\n      $extend-breakpoint: true;\n\n      @each $name, $width in $grid-breakpoints {\n        @if ($extend-breakpoint) {\n          .container#{breakpoint-infix($name, $grid-breakpoints)} {\n            @extend %responsive-container-#{$breakpoint};\n          }\n\n          // Once the current breakpoint is reached, stop extending\n          @if ($breakpoint == $name) {\n            $extend-breakpoint: false;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n","// Container mixins\n\n@mixin make-container($gutter: 1200px, xxl: 1400px))\n//    md\n//    >> breakpoint-next(sm, $breakpoint-names: (xs sm md lg xl xxl))\n//    md\n@function breakpoint-next($name, $breakpoints: $grid-breakpoints, $breakpoint-names: map-keys($breakpoints)) {\n  $n: index($breakpoint-names, $name);\n  @if not $n {\n    @error \"breakpoint `#{$name}` not found in `#{$breakpoints}`\";\n  }\n  @return if($n < length($breakpoint-names), nth($breakpoint-names, $n + 1), null);\n}\n\n// Minimum breakpoint width. }\n\n  // Responsive containers that are 100% wide until a breakpoint\n  @each $breakpoint, $container-max-width in $container-max-widths {\n    .container-#{$breakpoint} {\n      @extend .container-fluid;\n    }\n\n    @include media-breakpoint-up($breakpoint, $grid-breakpoints) {\n      %responsive-container-#{$breakpoint} {\n        max-width: $container-max-width;\n      }\n\n      // Extend each breakpoint which is smaller or equal to the current breakpoint\n      $extend-breakpoint: true;\n\n      @each $name, $width in $grid-breakpoints {\n        @if ($extend-breakpoint) {\n auto;\n}\n","// Breakpoint viewport sizes and media queries.\n//\n// Breakpoints are defined as a map of (name: minimum width), order from small to large:\n//\n//    (xs: 0, sm: 576px, md: 768px, lg: 992px, xl: 1200px, xxl: 1400px)\n//\n// The map defined in the `$grid-breakpoints` global variable is used as the `$breakpoints` argument by default.\n\n// Name of the next breakpoint, or null for the last breakpoint.\n//\n//    >> breakpoint-next(sm)\n//    md\n//    >> breakpoint-next(sm, (xs: 0, sm: 576px, md: 768px, lg: 992px, xl: 1200px, xxl: 1400px))\n//    md\n//    >> breakpoint-next(sm, $breakpoint-names: (xs sm md lg xl xxl))\n//    md\n@function breakpoint-next($name, $breakpoints: $grid-breakpoints, $breakpoint-names: map-keys($breakpoints)) {\n  $n: index($breakpoint-names, *,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  :root {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
  }
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--bs-body-font-family);
  font-size: var(--bs-body-font-size);
  font-weight: var(--bs-body-font-weight);
  line-height: var(--bs-body-line-height);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  text-align: var(--bs-body-text-align);
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
}

hr {
  margin: 1rem 0;
  color: inherit;
  border: 0;
  border-top: var(--bs-border-width) solid;
  opacity: 0.25;
}

h6, h5, h4, h3, h2, h1 {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.2;
  color: var(--bs-heading-color);
}

h1 {
  font-size: calc(1.375rem + 1.5vw);
}
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  h1 {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
  }
}

h2 {
  font-size: calc(1.325rem + 0.9vw);
}
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  h2 {
    font-size: 2rem;
  }
}

h3 {
  font-size: calc(1.3rem + 0.6vw);
}
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  h3 {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
  }
}

h4 {
  font-size: calc(1.275rem + 0.3vw);
}
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  h4 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
}

h5 {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
}

h6 {
  font-size: 1rem;
}

p {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

abbr[title] {
  -webkit-text-decoration: underline dotted;
  text-decoration: underline dotted;
  cursor: help;
  -webkit-text-decoration-skip-ink: none;
  text-decoration-skip-ink: none;
}

address {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  font-style: normal;
  line-height: inherit;
}

ol,
ul {
  padding-left: 2rem;
}

ol,
ul,
dl {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

ol ol,
ul ul,
ol ul,
ul ol {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

dt {
  font-weight: 700;
}

dd {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  margin-left: 0;
}

blockquote {
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
}

b,
strong {
  font-weight: bolder;
}

small {
  font-size: 0.875em;
}

mark {
  padding: 0.1875em;
  color: var(--bs-highlight-color);
  background-color: var(--bs-highlight-bg);
}

sub,
sup {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 0.75em;
  line-height: 0;
  vertical-align: baseline;
}

sub {
  bottom: -0.25em;
}

sup {
  top: -0.5em;
}

a {
  color: rgba(var(--bs-link-color-rgb), var(--bs-link-opacity, 1));
  text-decoration: underline;
}
a:hover {
  --bs-link-color-rgb: var(--bs-link-hover-color-rgb);
}

a:not([href]):not([class]), a:not([href]):not([class]):hover {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

pre,
code,
kbd,
samp {
  font-family: var(--bs-font-monospace);
  font-size: 1em;
}

pre {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  overflow: auto;
  font-size: 0.875em;
}
pre code {
  font-size: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  word-break: normal;
}

code {
  font-size: 0.875em;
  color: var(--bs-code-color);
  word-wrap: break-word;
}
a > code {
  color: inherit;
}

kbd {
  padding: 0.1875rem 0.375rem;
  font-size: 0.875em;
  color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  background-color: var(--bs-body-color);
  border-radius: 0.25rem;
}
kbd kbd {
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 1em;
}

figure {
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
}

img,
svg {
  vertical-align: middle;
}

table {
  caption-side: bottom;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

caption {
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  text-align: left;
}

th {
  text-align: inherit;
  text-align: -webkit-match-parent;
}

thead,
tbody,
tfoot,
tr,
td,
th {
  border-color: inherit;
  border-style: solid;
  border-width: 0;
}

label {
  display: inline-block;
}

button {
  border-radius: 0;
}

button:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: 0;
}

input,
button,
select,
optgroup,
textarea {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: inherit;
  line-height: inherit;
}

button,
select {
  text-transform: none;
}

[role=button] {
  cursor: pointer;
}

select {
  word-wrap: normal;
}
select:disabled {
  opacity: 1;
}

[list]:not([type=date]):not([type=datetime-local]):not([type=month]):not([type=week]):not([type=time])::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator {
  display: none !important;
}

button,
[type=button],
[type=reset],
[type=submit] {
  -webkit-appearance: button;
}
button:not(:disabled),
[type=button]:not(:disabled),
[type=reset]:not(:disabled),
[type=submit]:not(:disabled) {
  cursor: pointer;
}

::-moz-focus-inner {
  padding: 0;
  border-style: none;
}

textarea {
  resize: vertical;
}

fieldset {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  border: 0;
}

legend {
  float: left;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  font-size: calc(1.275rem + 0.3vw);
  line-height: inherit;
}
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  legend {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
}
legend + * {
  clear: left;
}

::-webkit-datetime-edit-fields-wrapper,
::-webkit-datetime-edit-text,
::-webkit-datetime-edit-minute,
::-webkit-datetime-edit-hour-field,
::-webkit-datetime-edit-day-field,
::-webkit-datetime-edit-month-field,
::-webkit-datetime-edit-year-field {
  padding: 0;
}

::-webkit-inner-spin-button {
  height: auto;
}

[type=search] {
  -webkit-appearance: textfield;
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

/* rtl:raw:
[type="tel"],
[type="url"],
[type="email"],
[type="number"] {
  direction: ltr;
}
*/
::-webkit-search-decoration {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
}

::-webkit-color-swatch-wrapper {
  padding: 0;
}

::-webkit-file-upload-button {
  font: inherit;
  -webkit-appearance: button;
}

::file-selector-button {
  font: inherit;
  -webkit-appearance: button;
}

output {
  display: inline-block;
}

iframe {
  border: 0;
}

summary {
  display: list-item;
  cursor: pointer;
}

progress {
  vertical-align: baseline;
}

[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}
